name: City of Albuquerque
notes: Accepts requests through ABQ Records/NextRequest, in person, or by mail; official City Clerk pages identify the clerk as chief records custodian.

name: City of Las Cruces
notes: Accepts written requests by mail, in person, fax, email, or online portal.

name: City of Rio Rancho
notes: Accepts NextRequest, email, fax, phone, mail, and in-person requests through the City Clerk.

name: Sandoval County
notes: County notice lists GovQA portal as preferred, with written requests accepted at the Legal Department or by email.

name: Santa Fe County
notes: Accepts online portal and mailed requests through the County Attorney's Office; separate custodians are listed for Clerk, Sheriff, and GIS records.

name: Albuquerque Public Schools
notes: Accepts NextRequest, fax, mail, and in-person delivery.

name: Rio Rancho Public Schools
notes: Official district IPRA page lists records custodian contact and an online public records request link.

name: Sandoval County Sheriff's Office
notes: Sheriff's Office services page links the public records portal and lists in-person and mail options for sheriff records.

name: Santa Fe County Sheriff's Office
notes: Sheriff page lists IPRA email and additional criteria for video/audio requests.

name: New Mexico Department of Finance and Administration
notes: IPRA page says requests should use the online form; mail and email are also listed.

name: New Mexico Department of Workforce Solutions
notes: Official DWS IPRA page lists mail, email, and phone contact for the records custodian.

name: New Mexico State Land Office
notes: Official IPRA page lists mail, email, and phone request options; footer lists agency fax.

name: New Mexico Institute of Mining and Technology
notes: Official public records page lists custodian, email, phone, and physical address.

name: New Mexico State University
notes: Preferred submission is NMSU's IPRA portal; requests also accepted by mail, in person, fax, and email.

name: University of New Mexico
notes: FAQ requests use of the IPRA portal and also lists mail, email, and phone contact for the Custodian of Public Records.

name: Bernalillo County Metropolitan court
notes: Centralized state portal. Must select "Bernalillo County Metropolitan Court" from the dropdown menu on the submission page.

name: Catron County
notes: A form with name, contact no. and P O has been given

name: Los Alamos County
notes: Official county IPRA page lists online, email, and in-person submission paths and identifies the records custodian.
